model.solver: scripts/usb_cross_section_fd.cpp, finite-volume electrostatics with harmonic dielectric interfaces; PCG residual<1e-9
equations: Codd=Qplus/1V; repeat same geometry in vacuum to obtain Codd0
model.geometry: Perfect rectangular copper; In1 idealGND. In2 trace thickness rounds to0.015mm at grids5/2.5um. Air above B and0.03048mm mask on unplated substrate; F mask0.03048mm between traces/0.01524mm over trace. No actual B signal conductors in base model.
model.coplanar_case: Ideal equipotential AC0 conductor outside both pair edges by0.15mm on In2. Conditional lower estimate: real+3V0 is not automaticallyGND, especially common mode or asymmetric gaps.
model.b_ground_case: Hypothetical continuous grounded B strip/plane0.2104mm from In2 copper. Not present in canonical.
model.tails: Not continuously parallel. front model is hypothetical paired F geometry; single cases estimate isolated traceZ0, not a Zdiff for separately routed tails.
model.validation_scope: Analytic parallel-plate sanity check, mesh and box convergence. Not independently calibrated against a commercial field solver or impedance coupon.
